---
title: "Basin: Efficient and Extensible Numerical Optimization in Rust"
description: >
  Basin is a numerical optimization library for Rust with a consistent interface
  for defining and solving problems, a broad solver catalog, and constraints.
author:
  - Johan Larsson
abstract: |
  Basin is a numerical optimization library for the Rust programming language.
  Numerical optimization is the task of finding the inputs that minimize a
  function, and it is a fundamental element across the sciences: fitting a model
  to data, calibrating a simulation, training a machine learning model, or choosing
  engineering parameters that minimize cost. Basin gives users a single,
  consistent way to both state and solve such problems, with a broad catalog of
  solvers and first-class support for constraints.
